_source: In-client glossary screen, transcribed 2026-08-14. These are OFFICIAL, stated by the game.
_status: All 18 values match the reverse-engineered battlepass.ru table EXACTLY. That table is now confirmed rather than unofficial, and the spec's standing caveat about it can be retired.
_consequence: Because the coefficients are now fixed and known-correct, any banner we cannot reproduce is a fault in our STAT MAPPING or MAP SELECTION — never in the coefficient. That inverts how every remaining discrepancy should be debugged.
_note: This file is reference data for the scoring engine in site-repo. derive.mjs deliberately holds no coefficients; it emits counts.

stats.definition: starts at 1950, -195 per death; the game does NOT clamp at zero
per last hit OR deny -> last_hits + denies
per LAST HIT on a tower -> towers_killed
per OBSERVER ward placed (sentries do not count)

per rune picked up OR BOTTLED. Our mapping uses rune_pickups; OpenDota's `runes` histogram sums identically, so if bottling is a distinct event neither field counts it. Nisha's banner needs 38 where we measure 37 — short by exactly one.
per CAPTURED watcher. Confirms it is a completed capture, not a click — ability_lamp_use fires on the click and overcounts. NO SOURCE YET.
per lotus PICKED UP. Confirms pickup semantics, so item_uses (eaten) was always the wrong shape. NO WORKING READING YET.
per Smoke of Deceit USED — no kill requirement in the wording, which argues against the prior art's 'only smokes used in a kill' theory

stats.definition: MAX 2124 — a 0..1 participation fraction scaled to the cap, not a per-unit rate
per SECOND of stun. OpenDota's `stuns` reproduced a client emblem to five decimals, so the definitions match.
per tormentor KILL. The wording says kill, not participation — which argues the last-hitter reading is right and the 'credits all participants' theory is wrong.
